translation: Food, drink, men, and women: the great desires are present. If one does not moderate and does not keep to time, and is licentious, disease arises; is this not wanting the disease? Death, illness, and suffering: the great evils are present. With cold and hot, attack and supplement, one urgently entrusts to the physician; is this not not allowing the disease? Even if the medicine arrives and the disease is removed, the qi and blood are already depleted; how is it better to regulate and nourish in advance? One does not know that taking medicine still relies on the person's own qi being vigorous to carry it; otherwise it is not easy to see merit. There are even those who suffer disease from medicine and then use medicine to treat the medicine; is the person not harmed? Supplementing medicines are especially not to be relied upon; the most supplementing are nothing like the five grains and six animals. If one did not eat but only took supplementing medicines, could one prolong the spirit? Everyone knows this is impossible. As for ginseng, it is only hot in nature and originally cannot supplement the vital qi of a person; for nourishing when there is no disease, it already seems one layer too much, and if used when there is disease, one immediately sees great harm. What joy is there? To occupy the name of wealth and harm oneself? The proverb says: Medicine cures the disease of those who will not die; the Buddha ferries those who have affinity.
